page.amendment_note: The Trade Marks Manual of Practice and Procedure has been updated to include a new Part 36, Revocation of Acceptance, Revocation of Registration, and Amendment or Cessation of Protection. Content previously contained in the separate chapters on revocation of acceptance and revocation of registration has been consolidated into this new chapter. For further information, refer to the official notices on the IP Australia website.
